modDetail.author: Sidrus
modDetail.longDescription:
Subdivisions lets you draw districts whose borders follow your networks instead of being painted on freehand. Drop a few nodes around an area and the tool traces the border along the networks between them, so the district lines up with your roads, rail, and paths. Use it to split a city into neighborhoods, plan zoning block by block, or lay out service areas along your existing streets.

## How to use

*   Activate the tool from its button in the top-left of the screen.
*   Left-click to drop boundary nodes around a block or neighborhood.
*   Click the first point again to close the ring and create the district.
*   Right-click to remove the last point.

A live preview and color-coded markers show the shape as you build it.

*   Magenta: Snapping to an area border
*   Yellow: Snapping to a network
*   Cyan: Free placement

## Snapping

Nodes snap to:

*   Most networks (intersections are preferred when you click near one)
*   Existing district boundaries
*   Map-tile borders
*   Shorelines

## Tracing

The border follows along the shortest route between nodes of the same kind. When two neighboring nodes sit on different kinds of networks or areas, they're joined with a straight line instead. Connections between two free-placed nodes is always a straight line. Note: shoreline tracing often needs Anarchy enabled due to how the iso-lines can bend. I'm working on adding a slider to simplify the trace to help.

## Recommended Mods

[Anarchy](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/74604/Windows) by yenyang isn't required, but it's handy to have around while creating districts.

## Version 0.2.2

*   Restored the live district preview while placing boundary points.
*   The tool no longer creates a district when the closed ring is invalid.

## Version 0.2.1

*   Fixed the tool committing a district every frame while hovering; the district is now created only when the boundary ring is closed.
*   Removed unused settings that remained from a legacy version.

## Version 0.2.0 - First Public Beta

First public beta release.

## Version 0.2.3

*   Fixed boundaries crossing themselves when two points sat on different network types (such as a road and a rail line).
*   Fixed districts collapsing into a thin sliver when two points were on the same road loop; the boundary now wraps the block between them.
*   Faster boundary tracing across large road networks.
